definitions.short: Chelkath Hats-tsurim , a place in Palestine
definitions.full: H2521. Chelqath Hatstsurim הַצֻּרִים חֶלְקַת proper name, of a location a place near pool of Gibeon where Ishbosheth's men were killed by David's men under Joab 2Sam 2:16 , ᵐ5 Μέρις τῶν ἐπιβούλων ; on meaning of name see I. חֶלְקָה above
definitions.rootNote: from 2520 and the plural of 6697 , with the article inserted; smoothness of the rocks;
